in_hebrew.name: גְרִיפִיאה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Griffie can be derived from the Hebrew word גְרִיף (gərîf), which means ‘strong’ or ‘mighty’. The suffix -יָה (yāh) is added to the name, which is a common Hebrew suffix meaning ‘belonging to God’. Therefore, the name Griffie in Hebrew can be translated as ‘Strong one belonging to God’ or ‘Heroic one belonging to God’.

in_greek.name: Γριφιέα
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Griffie can be derived from the Greek word γριφός (griphos), which means ‘strong’ or ‘fierce’. The suffix -ιέα (iēa) is added to the name, which is a common Greek suffix for feminine names. Therefore, the name Griffie in Greek can be translated as ‘Strong one’ or ‘Fierce one’.

in_latin.name: Grispia
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Griffie can be derived from the Latin word grispus, which means ‘rough’, ‘harsh’, or ‘fierce’. The suffix -ia is added to the name, which is a common Latin suffix for feminine names. Therefore, the name Griffie in Latin can be translated as ‘Struggle one’ or ‘Harsh one’.
